note: How to use Samestate with Claude Code, 75 s. The music is promo/music.py's track with bars 5-12 played four times (same tempo, 128 BPM). Every cue starts on a bar (1.875 s). The tool output shown in promo/tutorial.html is real: captured from the MCP server on the sample site before and after the fix.

cues.voice: Here's how to use Samestate with Claude Code.
Install the plugin with two commands, then restart Claude Code.
Ask Claude to check your page. Local dev servers work too.
Samestate opens the page on every screen in a hidden Chrome, and reports what breaks, with the exact element, and the CSS that usually fixes it.
Claude can look at any screen too, like this iPhone.
Then it fixes the cause in your own code. Here, the wide table and the small tab buttons.
And it checks again, so you know the fix worked, and what is left.
Or type slash Samestate check, with any address.
